    October 4, 2026, 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM

    Join us Sunday, October 4, from 1–4 PM for the Grand Opening of Phase 1 of Malden River Works Park! 🎉 Located at 356 Commercial Street, Malden River Works Park is Malden’s first riverfront park and features a restored landscape, new public boating dock, 200+ new trees, rain gardens, open lawn space and play features.
